fields.title: Medium article record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType is POST for an article, SURFACE for a reference probe and ERROR for a failure. _source says which surface a record came from, and that matters: tag and author records carry clap counts but only a preview, while publication records carry the article text but no clap counts - the source exposes one or the other, never both.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The tag, author, publication or URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: medium-tag-apollo-top | medium-tag-apollo-archive | medium-tag-apollo-recommended | medium-author-apollo | medium-publication-rss | medium-post-apollo | reference | error | none.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_query.title: Query
_query.description: The exact input value this record answers.

postId.title: Article ID
postId.description: The source's identifier for the article.

subtitle.title: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Article subtitle or standfirst, where one is published.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug, which ends in the article ID.

clapCount.title: Claps
clapCount.description: How many claps the article has - the source's engagement measure. Present on tag, author and post records; always null on publication records, because the publication feed publishes no engagement figures.

responseCount.title: Responses
responseCount.description: How many responses (comments) the article has.

isPaywalled.title: Behind the paywall
isPaywalled.description: True for member-only articles. These serve only their opening paragraphs to anyone not signed in.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: The source's own visibility value, e.g. LOCKED or PUBLIC.

isSeries.title: Is a series
isSeries.description: True when the article is part of a series.

publishedAt.title: Published
publishedAt.description: First publication time as ISO 8601 UTC.

updatedAt.title: Last updated
updatedAt.description: Most recent publication time as ISO 8601 UTC.

publishedAtEpochMs.title: Published (epoch ms)
publishedAtEpochMs.description: Publication time exactly as published, in epoch milliseconds.

publishedAtRaw.title: Published (as published)
publishedAtRaw.description: Publication date string from the publication feed, e.g. 'Wed, 17 Sep 2026 12:00:00 GMT'.

updatedAtRaw.title: Updated (as published)
updatedAtRaw.description: Update timestamp string from the publication feed.

authorId.title: Author ID
authorId.description: The source's identifier for the author.

authorBio.title: Author bio
authorBio.description: Author's bio, where the page includes it.

authorFollowers.title: Author followers
authorFollowers.description: Author's follower count, where the page includes it.

publicationName.title: Publication
publicationName.description: Publication the article appeared in, if any.

publicationSlug.title: Publication slug
publicationSlug.description: Publication's URL slug - a stable key for grouping.

publicationId.title: Publication ID
publicationId.description: The source's identifier for the publication.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Topics the article is filed under.

tagQueried.title: Tag queried
tagQueried.description: Tag mode: the topic this article was found under, which is not necessarily its first tag.

tagSection.title: Tag section
tagSection.description: Tag mode: top, archive or recommended.

authorQueried.title: Author queried
authorQueried.description: Author mode: the handle that was requested.

previewImageAlt.title: Preview image alt text
previewImageAlt.description: Alt text of the article's lead image.

previewImageId.title: Preview image ID
previewImageId.description: The source's image identifier for the lead image.

hasFullContent.title: Preview carries full content
hasFullContent.description: The source's own flag on the preview card. It describes the card, not the article page, so do not read it as 'the body is complete' - use isTruncated for that.

contentHtml.title: Article content (HTML)
contentHtml.description: Publication mode: the article body as published. See contentSource - for some articles the feed carries only a short preview instead.

contentText.title: Article content (plain text)
contentText.description: The same content with markup stripped.

contentSource.title: Where the content came from
contentSource.description: 'content:encoded' for the full article, 'description' for a short preview. In one measured feed, 4 of 10 articles carried the full text (7,536 characters) and 6 carried a preview (about 80), so this tells you which you got.

isContentFull.title: Content is the full article
isContentFull.description: True only when the feed carried the complete article rather than a preview.

paragraphCount.title: Paragraph count
paragraphCount.description: Post mode: how many paragraphs were served. A member-only article serves about 8; a free one served 77.

bodyText.title: Article text
bodyText.description: Post mode: the article text, paragraphs joined.

paragraphs.title: Paragraphs
paragraphs.description: Post mode: each paragraph with its type (H3, P, IMG and so on), text and link.

isTruncated.title: Body is truncated
isTruncated.description: Post mode: true when the source served only the opening of the article, which happens for member-only articles. Free articles come through complete.

probedUrl.title: Probed URL
probedUrl.description: Reference mode: the URL that was checked.

isAvailable.title: Source available
isAvailable.description: Reference mode: whether the source returned parseable data.

note.title: Note
note.description: Reference mode: what happened, in words.

winningTlsProfile.title: Winning browser profile
winningTlsProfile.description: Reference mode: which browser fingerprint the source accepted from this address.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: Reference mode: measured evidence - usable and hollow article counts per surface, and whether publications still need the feed rather than the page.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure reason: not_found, shape_changed, blocked_or_transient, no_items_in_feed, invalid_tag, invalid_author, invalid_publication, invalid_post.

engagement.title: Top by claps
engagement.description: Sort by claps to see what is working in a topic.

content.title: Article text
content.description: The article bodies, with a flag for whether each is complete.
